caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical object placed on a rectangular, light brown box with a green band along its lower edge. The box has visible wood grain and a small crank handle on the right side. On top of the box, to the left, there is a circular platform holding a group of eight small, tan-colored carved human figures arranged in a circle. Each figure has defined arms and is dressed in a long garment with a hat; there appears to be a hint of green color at the neck area of each figure. To the right of the group, there are two slightly larger figures, also similarly dressed with hats and long garments, but the rightmost figure is holding what appear to be sheaves of wheat or a bundle of elongated objects above its head. Between the two figures is a triangular, flat, upright panel. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. The name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is written in capital letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Pa. German Music Box
